description: Evaluate whole-window movement trends before localizing events; suppress recurring oscillation phases and small steps within an unchanged pattern, and verify aircraft identity against raw action/state rows.
changes: Make whole-window pattern assessment precede local onset selection.
Treat recurrent oscillation phases and small steps within the same underlying pattern as continuation.
Keep short developing departures near the right edge eligible; do not require the new behavior to dominate the window.
Recheck same-object action/state rows and heading ID mapping; cite raw before/after action triplets in event reasons.
Merge duplicate mentions of one aircraft/onset.
